data.action: 在游乐设施前开心比心
data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 游乐园夏日】阳光灿烂的游乐园摩天轮下，穿着明艳夏日私服的海梦戴着可爱的卡通发箍，一边大口咬着彩虹棉花糖，一边朝你比出大大的爱心手势——「今天一整天都超级开心！接下来去坐过山车还是鬼屋？只要和你一起，去哪里我都超超超期待！」
data.promptProse: Marin pauses beneath the theme-park Ferris wheel after enjoying rainbow cotton candy, resting its wrapper beside her on the rail and forming a large heart with both hands toward the viewer. Her bright gyaru cropped top and skirt retain the street outfit. The medium view includes roller-coaster curves and summer clouds behind. Strong daylight illuminates the cotton candy's colors and her laughing face, with rail shadows crossing the paved attraction area.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 游乐园夏日
